Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vihaan - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Sonali - 37 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Anil - 44 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Sonali and Anil stand near him.]

Sonali: "Vihaan, what's the plan today?"

[Vihaan reads a storybook.]

Vihaan: "That was fun!"

[Vihaan writes in his notebook.]

Anil (happily): "Show me too!"

[Vihaan does his homework at the table.]

Anil: "Okay, Vihaan."

[Vihaan talks to his father on the phone.]

Vihaan (gently): "Dad, listen!"

[Vihaan's phone rings and he answers it.]

Vihaan (happily): "That was fun!"

[Vihaan types on his laptop.]

Vihaan: "Okay, Mom."

[Vihaan watches cartoons on TV.]

Vihaan: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Anil: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan nods.]

Anil: "Vihaan, are you okay?"

[Vihaan takes the bag from Mother.]

Vihaan (gently): "I'm ready!"

[Vihaan slips and falls.]

Vihaan (excited): "Show me too!"

[Vihaan hurts his knee.]

Vihaan: "Yes, all right."

[A light drizzle begins.]

Sonali: "Vihaan, are you okay?"

Scene 3: The terrace - Day

Sonali: "Vihaan, look over here."

[Vihaan flies a kite on the terrace.]

Sonali: "That was such a fun day!"
